youtube.title: 🔥 Turn Any Webpage Into an AI Agent in One Line
youtube.description: Tired of building complex backend APIs just to add AI features to your web app? Page Agent from Alibaba lets you turn any webpage into an AI-powered interface with a single script tag. No browser extensions, no Python, no headless browsers—just pure client-side JavaScript that works with any LLM, including locally deployed models. Users can control your entire web app through natural language commands, turning twenty-click workflows into single sentences. It's already earned 4,000+ stars because it works out of the box with mainstream models like Qwen, GPT, and Claude. Perfect for adding AI copilots to SaaS products, making admin panels accessible through voice commands, or building smart form-filling features for ERP and CRM systems. The repo includes a Chrome extension for multi-page tasks and even an MCP server for external control. MIT licensed and ready to ship today.

linkedin.text:
🚨 You're burning developer hours building backend APIs just to add AI features to your web app.

Every new copilot feature means:
→ New endpoints
→ Complex orchestration logic
→ Screenshot handling or multimodal APIs
→ Browser automation infrastructure

And your users still have to click through twenty form fields manually.

🛠️ Alibaba just open sourced Page Agent—one script tag that turns any webpage into an AI-controlled interface.

No screenshots. No browser extensions. No headless Python. Just client-side JavaScript that reads your DOM as text so any standard LLM can drive it.

Here's what you get:
✅ Works with your own LLMs (Qwen, GPT, Claude, even local models)
✅ One-line integration—no backend rewrite required
✅ 4,000+ GitHub stars from teams shipping it in production

Next time your users need to fill an ERP form, they just say it once. Your CRM becomes voice-controlled. Your admin panel becomes accessible to screen readers with zero extra code.

The repo includes a Chrome extension for multi-page automation and an MCP server for external agent control. MIT licensed, TypeScript-native, and production-ready today.

Search GitHub for Page Agent to see the full implementation. Have you tried adding AI copilots to legacy web apps before—what blocked you?
